findings: Headed alphabet table supports distinction of ma fourth order and me fifth order; source p118 final noun first glyph resembles fourth-order ma. Yaman full row supplies the ye fifth-order shape matching second syllable. I provisionally read ማየ, a water-form, not fifth-order me plus ye.
Photographed pp211-212 water head ማይ / ማየ lists aqua and aqua diluvii, with plural treatment. PP213 inspected for neighboring continuation, not needed to invent an alternate head.
Photographed pp635-638 ነሥአ entry supports take/lift/raise meanings (suscipere, tollere, elevare); actual finite source stem must still be checked, not inferred solely from head.

Photographed pp715-716 identifies ኢ as negative particle, with prohibitive/hortatory usage ne with subjunctive. Therefore negative command that they should not lift is a legitimate possible rendering if source verb is ይንሥኡ.
Photographed pp299-300 ራእይ entry gives visio/vision, aspect/spectacle, appearance; these meanings cannot be imported merely because p118 contains an earlier showing verb.
Photographed pp341-342 inspected as additional control, not semantic evidence for disputed noun.
limits: Provisional source word identity is independent but not a claim of human specialist qualification. Preserve all source-critical and publication holds.
